title: Python Development for Odoo
tagline: Develop advanced Odoo backend skills using Python, ORM, relationships, computed logic, constraints, APIs, testing, and optimization.
description: This is not a generic Python course. It is designed for developers who want to apply Python to live ERP requirements, structured business data, workflow rules, integrations, and maintainable Odoo modules.
The track gives extra attention to backend reasoning: how records behave, how relationships are modeled, where logic belongs, and how code supports operational accuracy.
learningOutcomes: Model complex business data using the Odoo ORM
Write maintainable Python business logic and validations
Connect backend models with XML interfaces and workflows
Build advanced modules and extension patterns
Integrate, debug, test, optimize, and document Odoo solutions
whoItsFor: Python developers moving into Odoo technical work
Backend engineers applying data modeling and business logic skills inside the Odoo ORM
Module builders creating advanced modules, extensions, and reusable technical solutions
Freelance developers preparing for technical Odoo customization and integration projects
requirements: Confident Python fundamentals and object-oriented programming
Basic relational database and SQL understanding

faq.question: Is this a beginner Python course?
faq.answer: No. It assumes confidence with Python fundamentals and focuses on applying Python inside Odoo.

faq.question: How is it different from Odoo Development?
faq.answer: This track goes deeper into Python, the ORM, data modeling, backend logic, testing, and optimization. Odoo Development covers the broader framework workflow — architecture, views, actions, and integrations.

faq.question: Will APIs be included?
faq.answer: Yes. The curriculum includes external connections and data-exchange patterns.

faq.question: Is there a portfolio project?
faq.answer: Yes. The capstone is intended to demonstrate Python-driven Odoo development through a complete business solution.
